entries.title: Monitor loading — frontmatter index instead of full snapshot
entries.affected_document: docs/05_architecture.md, docs/us/US-0076.md, docs/sprints/v2-S6.md, docs/versions/v2.md, project-loader.ts, ProjectDataContext.tsx
entries.what_changed: Planned US-0076 (v2-S6): on folder open, build a lightweight index (list + frontmatter parse) instead of loading all markdown bodies into React state. Full files read on demand via FileSystemDirectoryHandle when opening sheets/readers. Sprint v2-S6 added to v2.
entries.why_changed: Monolithic loadMeridianProject caused slow open and indefinite loading spinner on dogfood docs/ (75+ US); disk is already source of truth — mirroring entire tree in memory is the wrong model for browser v1 monitor.
entries.impact: 05_architecture.md v1.2 documents current vs index-first target under Loading. Implementation via /refine-us US-0076 then code. US-0059 watcher can refresh index only later.
